## Change scope
What changed and why?

## Acceptance traceability
List AC-N identifiers, implementing files, and hosted-runner tests (when an executable Issue exists).

## Evidence
Paste relevant CI run links; never paste credentials, private data, or unredacted logs.

## Merge policy (CI-only)
No independent reviewer approval is required. Merge only after all mandatory CI and acceptance gates pass on the current head SHA, with no conflicts or hold label. Protected-path changes require explicit owner/policy authorization, not a second-person review.

## Protected-path authorization
If this PR changes workflows, security configuration, permissions, or protected paths, reference the owner/policy authorization and required passing checks.
